title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Watermelon Lemonade 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Watermelon Lemonade is an irresistibly refreshing collision of succulent Watermelon and zesty Lemonade that captures the very essence of summertime in a vape. The moment you inhale, your tastebuds are greeted with the refreshing, delicate sweetness of ripe Watermelon slices, freshly cut and dripping with juicy goodness. This luscious Watermelon flavour creates a smooth and satisfying foundation that freshens your senses for what's coming next. Just when you think the experience can't get any more delicious, a wave of tangy, bubbly Lemonade crashes onto the scene. It's as if you're sipping on a glass of homemade Lemonade, freshly squeezed and perfectly chilled. The Lemonade not only adds a zesty kick but also balances the sweetness of the Watermelon, resulting in a well-rounded and immensely satisfying vape. By crafting this extraordinary flavour profile, Doozy Vape Co invites you to take a break from the ordinary and step into a world of vibrant, fruity delight. Whether you're a seasoned vaper or a newcomer looking for something special, Watermelon Lemonade promises an unforgettable vaping experience that is nothing short of spectacular. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
